title: New York Helicopter Tour: Manhattan Highlights
description: Get a perspective on New York City that most visitors miss when you take to the air for a scenic helicopter tour. See Manhattan’s most iconic sights, from the Empire State Building to Central Park, in a matter of minutes; you even catch a glimpse of the majestic Statue of Liberty.

reviews.usertext:
You get exactly what you’re hiring: a 12-15 min flight around (not over) Manhattan and Liberty Island…

The guys operating the business are friendly and look professional and reliable.

On the downside: they give you a location on the chopper according to your weight in order to keep the maximum weight balance on board. The problem is that there’s a relevant difference in the whole experience depending on the place you’re given. People on the right side or in the front seat get neater and closer views than those sitting on the left side (needless to say I got a left side seat).

As for the price, it’s a matter of demand and supply. 260 $/person x 6 people/trip x 20+ trips/day… I’m not much into chopper trip costs, but it looks like too much. But, as I said, every slot was booked when I made my reservation. Good business !

So easy to book on line and the price was great. The welcome at the Heliport was friendly, welcoming,professional and everyone’s safety was paramount. Dave the pilot gave a great commentary (even though it was his first day haha) I would recommend using these guys for an unforgettable part of your NY trip.

Seeing the Manhattan skyline from an aerial view was nothing short of breathtaking. It was an idea from our 5-year old daughter who saw it from a learning cartoon series where the characters flew in a helicopter to see the Statue of Liberty. She wanted to do the exact same thing! We all never been on a helicopter ride, so we asked a number of times whether she was sure. Each time she was confident with her answer, YES. We picked HeliNY and we were glad we made the right choice. Upon arrival, the amazing staff were professional, and removed any anxiety from flying which made the experience even more memorable. They were able to squeeze us into the 30-min ride because there was available seats on one of the helicopters. I definitely recommend the 30 min excursion because you don’t feel rushed and get a more time to soak in the breathtaking views of Manhattan. It’s something every one needs to try once in their lives. Add it to the bucket list! Thank you HeliNY!!!

I booked a helicopter ride for my boyfriend and I, and we were amazed by how beautiful the city was from the sky! Helicopter Flight Services was seamless to book and board, and the helicopter ride was smooth and relaxing. If you are new to NYC or have lived in NYC for years -- I highly recommend this ride. We started at the bottom of the East River, made our way around the Statue of Liberty, and went all the way up to the George Washington Bridge. To say it was gorgeous was an understatement.

We arrived about an hour and a half early due to being worried about the upcoming storm. They took us right in and we got to ride before the storm arrived, for which we were grateful. It was really fun! Our pilot was great and made the flight jokative yet informative!

Can thoroughly recommend this tour and this company. The whole experience was very professionally handled and the pilot provided a running commentary throughout the flight . The helicopters are ideally fitted with large windows so wherever you sit you get brilliant views.

Yes, it is expensive at around 200$ pp for a 12 minute flight, but it's a lifetime memory and worth it - so just do it.
It was a fantastic experience - great and unforgettable flight over NYC, and my very first on a helicopter.
TIP: if you're about to have bad weather, just call them and reschedule, like we did. Only 2 hours before our initial flight on May, 2 we asked them to reschedule us for tomorrow due to bad and cloudy, rainy weather. They approved that within minutes.
Company to recommend.

The experience was great. 15 minutes flies by but at the same time, the pilot keeps you informed of what you’re seeing at each step. The ground staff are efficient and get you where you need to go. It was a man easy experience once you arrive. It was definitely a highlight for us and is definitely something that is worth the expense. It is worth searching online for a discount code too as there is usually one available to knock a few extra dollars off!

We ordered the 12-15 minutes tour over Manhattan. As the weather was not good on the day of reservation, we were called to rebook the flight. Two days later we could do the flight in perfect conditions and we even got an upgrade to the 18 minutes flight. When visiting New York the Helicopter tour with HeliNY is a must do !

Brilliant tour. Was a bit nervous throughout as I am not a great flyer but the pilot was lovely and professional and I felt very safe. I had to reschedule this tour numerous times due to covid and the customer service was just brilliant at promptly getting back to me and changing the days/times for our tour. You can tell safety is taken very serious here which i liked. The flight itself was fantastic. 10/15 minutes is plenty of time to see the sights. Seeing the statue of liberty and the skyline from above is just incredible, something you will never forget. Thoroughly enjoyed it, was a highlight of the trip.

Everything was very good!

Good organisation, nice people and safe! The only "bad" thing was that we booked a 12-15 minute tour and at the front desk they told us we got an upgrade for the 20 Minute tour for free. But that wasn't the fact it was actually the 12-15 Minute tour.

But I highly recommend this tour!

One of the best things we did on our 4 day trip to NY.
Myself, my husband and both our children (13 and 20) loved it. Well organised and great, friendly pilot. It is short, about 15 to 20 mins but I would highly recommend and go as far as to say that once you have done this you wouldn't necessarily have to go up the Empire State Building, Top of the Rock or any other skyscraper as you would never better the view you can get from the helicopter.

Great views but not great enough to pay $800 for under 15 minutes of time in flight. Pilot was nice and very knowledgeable. Rushed you through everything and audio wasn’t on for safety presentation so you could only watch and not hear what you were supposed to do. Great views are the only good thing I can say.

This is my 3rd helicopter ride (and the best).

Also, its my third trip to NYC and I wish I had this when I first came.

The view are spectacular, the entire company from the crew chief – pilot and desk staff are friendly outgoing people.

The safety video was thorough and its clear safety is first with this team, as we were clearly led to the copter by the crew chief with lines along the asphalt.

The ride is both relaxing (I have fear of heights) but exhilarating as well The price is right for the thrill

There were two staff members in front of the building ready to greet us. The facility was extremely clean including the restrooms. The boarding process and the safety procedures were explained clearly and succinctly. The pilot was calm and pointed out key sights. The helicopter was extremely quiet with the headset provided and it was quite incredibly stable. Only wish it had been longer!

It was my first time in helicopter, and it was a good experience. Sadly, it was cloudy and windy, so it wasn't as great as it could be. For sure, the experience would had been nicer in better weather, but this can't be controlled!

I would only say one negative thing: you pay a lot of money for the experience (I'm not saying it should be a cheap activity to do) but they could include the picture they take from you in front of the helicopter, instead of charge you 35 more dollars (it's crazy $35 for just one simple picture they take in 5 seconds in front of the helicopter).

Good and worth it experience.

10/12/2022
Beware when buying this as a gift for clients or family! HeliNY then asks them to pay additional fees, because when you buy a gift certificate you supposedly aren't buying the experience but just the cash value and then they add on additional fees/charges.

Firstly, very embarrassing to give this as gift to clients and then have them tell me they were asked to pay. Secondly, management didn't do much to help situation even though there is nothing on my receipt or their website that specifies this.

I'm sure the helicopter ride is beautiful but poor customer service experience.

Absolutely amazing experience. Everybody incredibly friendly and professional. Helicopters were new and clean. Everything very well maintained for covid (temperature check, hand sanitizer, masks, disinfected everything after each group of passengers, etc.) Highly highly recommend!!

The tour was nice everything was organized
And clean. But I would the ride was very quick not worth $400 and very congested 7 of us in the helicopter. Since it’s covid it sud be no more then 3 or 4 people. I couldn’t sit next to my husband either because another couple wanted to sit together so they made him sit in the front which I thought wasn’t fare. 😕 and they took one picture of us and we had to buy it for $40.

Great team , cool pilot and ground staff who all made us feel very relaxed and comfortable. Brilliant flight seeing all the key sites. We had a beautiful day of weather which helped. All in all would recommend for a truly memorable experience!

I booked this experience the night before for myself & partner who was a little nervous at first but loved it. Pros: smooth take-off and landing, the pilot was very friendly & I got to ride up front. Cons: staff weren't particularly engaging, the chopper seats 6 passengers so if you're a couple sharing with other couples, the lightest will be sat upfront. If you're visiting & it's a once in a lifetime trip then I'd definitely recommend this, well worth the money but if you can stretch a little more, do the whole city!

September 05, 2022 was my boyfriend’s birthday and I decided to surprise him with a HeliNY helicopter ride. I booked the 15 min ride on 09/01 for 3:30 PM and later changed my reservation to 12:30 PM because it was Labor Day. Both the HeliNY and booking associates were very accommodating to this change. On the day of our tour I arrive 15 minutes before the flight, however my boyfriend was still stuck in traffic and did not arrive until almost 1 PM. The HeliNY staff working that day were very kind and accommodating to this. They allowed us to catch the next tour that was starting at 1:30 PM. The tour was nothing short of amazing. My boyfriend had a great time and we saw so many sites. We saw all the sites listed in the description and our favorite was the Statue of Liberty. As New Yorkers ourselves we do not get the opportunity to truly enjoy the landmarks that we have so it was a wonderful day to do so. If you’re contemplating on whether or not you should do this or whether or not the money is worth it please believe me that it is.

This was a good experience and we’re glad we did it. However, it was very pricey for what you actually get. Upon arrival there is a conveyer belt line to get you on the helicopter, somewhat confusing where to stand and what to do - lots of instructions fired at you. On the helicopter it was BOILING hot which made the experience pretty uncomfortable. Saw some good sights, albeit very quickly. Not really any commentary from the pilot. Overall it did feel like they were trying to push as many people through as quickly as possible rather than focusing on the quality of the experience. The stars are mainly awarded for the quality of the view.

Flying in a helicopter was very enjoyable. The staff could of been friendlier as it felt like they were just pushing through the numbers of people to go on a ride. They had no hand soap in the womens bathroom.
Security check in was a bit casual and the guy missed doing the metal detecting wand check on the couple behind us. We noted this because their should be higher security in this environment. We are constantly reminded to never forget the legacy of the attack of the twin towers 21 years ago.

We highly recommend trying this experience with HeliNy. The helicopter ride was smooth and the views of Manhattan from above were breathtaking!

The location was very easy to find and all COVID protocols were followed for check-in. The staff was very friendly and before the flight, we were briefed on some safety procedures.

During the flight, the pilot was also a great guide who pointed out everything as we passed over. The flight itself was around 15 minutes but in my opinion, it was more than enough to experience Manhattan from above!

Make sure to try this experience when visiting NYC and you wont regret it!

Staff were friendly and accommodating. We were welcomed at the front and checkin with warm ambience. I was with my boyfriend but feeling uncomfortable as the guy who took us out kept flirting and ask for my number, not good as my flight could have been better but felt uneasy

Cannot thank enough the team of HeliNY for the unforgettable experience I had. Everything was handled with care and courtesy , from the security agent at the entrance, the front desk staff , and the skilled and attentive pilot, I was luck enough to sit by his side. The trip to NYC become even more spectacular seeing the city from above. Don’t hesitate to book HeliNY services if a helicopter tour is in your holiday plans.

The heliport is easy to find. The checkin is very quick and easy. You have complementary lockers for your personal belongings, so everything is safe. After a short waiting time while watching a video you get a safety instruction. While boarding you walk around the heliport and you can see the helicopter starting and landing. The modern helicopter we were flying with was beautiful and easy to get in.
Once in the air, you can see the Statue of Liberty, one world, Empire State Building and the Central Park.

All in all worth the money and an awesome flight journey.

A good flight. Knocked off a star because at checkin we were asked to sign a waiver “due to Covid-19”. The waiver turned out to be much broader than that - to the point where trying to be made whole after any accident would be very difficult, IMO. We took the ride anyway, and enjoyed it. Just be aware that passengers seem to be expected to bear whatever risk is involved. Read the fine print!

The helicopter experience itself was fantastically unforgettable and well worth it. The ride takes you up and down the Hudson and an awesome birds eye view of Liberty and Ellis Island
From the moment we arrived, the process was very slick and impersonal. The comms in the helicopter poor, so we couldn’t hear the commentary There is also a middle seat in the back where the view is impeded by those seated either side

Had a very nice helicopterflight today! It was rescheduled a day before due to bad weather but it was handeled great. I could fly on a much beter day with great weather. Staff is very friendly and helpfull. Awesome experience!

Everything goes smoothly, everyone is very nice and the view from the helicopter is breathtaking. We had The New Yorker tour and we got to see everything from the Statue of Liberty to Central Park included. We loved every minute of it. The pilot was very helpful and explained everything we were seeing.

Had an amazing flight with this crew that were professional, engaging and humorous! The helicopter was comfortable and felt that they took great care both in the sky and in preparing folks. The views are priceless. It was my friends 50th - and she didn't know we were doing it until we got there - and she loved it. A great way to mark a milestone!

Amazing experience. It was awesome! The staff was very knowledgeable and friendly. The ride was 20 minutes in total, and it was a breathtaking experience. We flew over Manhattan and saw the Statue of Liberty from above, something I will never forget.
It’s a bit pricey but totally worth it.

We took this trip as a family and just loved it! It was a unique and amazing way to experience the city. The staff was very friendly and the pilot helped us look at the right spots while telling stories along the way. Highly recommended!

Excellent way to end our stay in NY City. The views on this trip are truly breathtaking. The pilots running commentary throughout the flight was excellent. Bose headsets provided. 100% recommend this experience to anyone visiting NY.

It was an experience that I have been waiting to do for many years and finally got the chance to do it with two other friends and everything was ok for the most part but for me the biggest letdown was the main reason why I was doing it which was to see the Statue of Liberty. I was very disappointed with how faaar away the flight stayed from the Statue of Liberty. I thought we would go at least somewhat closer than what it was. that was very disappointing for me because I always imagined that when we finally did the helicopter tour it would take us at least considerably closer than that long range distance that it stayed away from the statue and I hate to say it but that was a real turn off for me. Everything else was ok but after having done it once For what it costs I doubt that I’d be interested in doing it again. I’m glad I didn’t pay for the longer tour, the short one was good enough.

It was ok, a nice ride to overview all Manhattan, the ride was good, nice and friendly pilot. Had a very clear sky wich it helped a lot.

The toilets were absolutely disgusting and the guy in the photoshop should be doing something else but attending customers. Very bad mannered chap and very unpleasant. Nothing to do with the rest o f the staffo who were friendly and professional.

i recommend this activity.

Thank you so much guys! I managed to cock up the dates but they helped us out and got us on another flight. No hassle at all. Very professional, courteous and friendly to deal with. Obviously, I would highly recommend using New York Helicopter Tours.

This journey has been amazing! I loved the ride so much. The weather was perfect too. They practiced COVID safety protocols and were very professional. The staff and pilot were awesome. They made my experience even better! I will try the other packages with them. I highly recommend this company.

Well worth the money!! The experience was priceless. Myself & 2 friends did the Manhattan Highlights tour & it was an amazing experience. My friend & I were super anxious about flying but the staff was so friendly & funny. They made us feel super comfortable. The pilots were great. Very knowledgeable, funny & great tour guides. Can’t wait to go back & take a longer flight!! BOOK HELINY 🚁

Perfect experience from start to finish.
Super friendly service, great atmosphere, really customer friendly.
I rarely give 5 star reviews with such confidence and pleasure.
You guys made my day. And more! Thank you

Thoroughly recommend this company and the service. So glad I did this it’s an amazing way of piecing together NewYork. Made even better as I was in the co pilots seat. A grandstand view. Would do it again next at night with all the lights twinkling.

New York Helicopter is a FANTASTIC business! The employees are fabulous. They are kind, helpful, professional, hardworking and very safe. This tour is VERY worth the money and cool! Special thanks Jose Acosta, Magnus, Brian and Roberto!!!

We arrived a little early and the team at HeliNY couldn’t do enough for us. They managed to bring our flight forward and accommodate us. We had very friendly and engaging staff support us and get us out. David the pilot was charming and funny, he made the flight extra special too.

Would definitely recommend!

Nor sure why there might be any bad reviews for this. The whole experience was seemless. Arrived a bit early, we waited and was given an update on how it will go. Security check, safety info and we we're all set. Great experience and the pilot was great. Good info during flight and amazingly views. Would highly recommend. Staff were slick and to the point no hidden surprises here. Top draw.

Amazing!! we loved the trip, was really nice. We arrived earlier and they allowed us to take our turn earlier. The take-off, flight, and landing went really smoothly!

I want to go again, next time will be at night!!

Thanks and cheers to all the kind team.

The trip was so amazing, we had the best time. Luckily the weather was fantastic and therefore it just made it all that much better. The whole team of staff was so friendly and made us feel very comfortable. Shout out to Miguel who wished me happy birthday.

Well worth the money.Fab new helicopters,excellent mode of transport.Clear vision,good pilot commentary and lovely friendly staff all round.
Views were magnificent. Amazing how much you can see in 15 minutes.Seems much longer.You feel absolutely safe and secure.

I chose the helicopter tour of 15 minutes for 2. I booked online, a week in advance. We enjoyed the online discount.
The service is great! The staff answer e-mails within 24hours and are super friendly.

The flight is definitely worth the money. It’s a once in a lifetime experience, and the staff of HeliNY will make sure it’s an unforgettable and pleasant one.

The experience is something I will never forget. It was my mom’s 65th birthday and our first time in the helicopter. The view was beautiful however we could barely hear our tour guide. I’m not sure if it was the air traffic controller we could hear or someone else. So we really did not know what we were looking at except the Statue of Liberty 🗽. Overall the staff was extremely nice and helpful.

We are delighted from our flight. We bought tour online, so we was a little bit nervous about it. But everything was amazing. The HeliNY team is very professional and with a very good service. It was a present for my husband’s Birthday and it was a very good decision to make our flight with HeliNY.

Brilliant experience and such a helpful, professional company. We were stuck in traffic and weren’t going to make our reservation, rang from the cab and rescheduled for later the same day, so easy and stress free! Excellent staff, all very friendly, especially Edward and our pilot David. Highly recommend, you won’t be disappointed.

Loved the whole experience from the moment we arrived at the Heliport. Staff were friendly and professional upon arrival. Our pilot pointed out the various sites during the flight and we had great views of Manhattan. Was a fabulous experience and one of the highlights of our trip to NY.

This has been the best 15 minutes of my time in New York. We took the helicopter tour and from start to finish everyone was so friendly l. We were taken really good care of and everything was explained clearly. We arrived early for our flight and they put us on an earlier tour which was greatly appreciated A must do for your stay in NYC!

My friend and I booked the Ultimate tour and were impressed with the quality of the aircraft and the well run process to board etc. this was all very professional and made us feel safe.
However, we were pretty disappointed at the lack of commentary during the flight. As a first timer to NYC, I had thought that we would get a pretty good overview of the city. Unfortunately the only commentary we got was having the following pointed out:
- Statue of Liberty
- Freedom tower
- Empire State Building
- Central Park
We didn’t feel that asking questions was appropriate.
So I have to say we were a little disappointed.

I went all by myself and was scared to death at first but this experience was just so amazing! You get swept away by a wave of adrenaline and totally forget about your fear. Everyone is so professional and kind - 5 stars from me! Truly a once in a lifetime experience!

Great customer service, we even got an earlier flight because we arrived earlier at the heliport. Great views including Manhattan, Brooklyn bridge, New Jersey, Statue of Liberty and so much more. We recommend this flight to see NYC.

Highly recommend doing this while you’re in the city! Absolutely fantastic, from beginning to end and everything in between. Great staff, great service, and amazing views; best way to see NYC and NJ! You won’t regret it!
I have always wanted to fly over NYC & see the Skyline by night. Our pilot Christina was so nice. This was a dream come true. Great amazing awesome ! I totally recommend.

Highly recommendable experience starting with excellent service and prompt answers from Kathleen Wiig and Laila Lau . Due to heavy fog we had a almost 2 hour delay , but were constantly informed of the weather conditions and reception personnel very friendly , thanks Eddie & company !
Pilot Sam gave full info the whole flight .
there were other passengers complaing of the delay but hey ???? you want to fly and see nothing ? Apart from safety issues ?
For us the experience was wonderful- thanks guyss !!!!
I had a blast flying with HeliNY! I flew over NYC right up front with a great pilot with great insight and willingness to ensure I had a great time!
The experience was amazing. The staff was very welcoming. They adhered to the COVID-19 guidelines. The service was fast.I will definitely visit again.
Best experience ever! I was so nervous before but the staff and pilot made me feel so safe. Amazing views of the city highly recommend.

My husband took me to this tour for my birthday and we couldn’t have had a more amazing experience flying throughout the New York skyline! The service was great and we learned a lot about the city from up above! This is a great way to explore the city if you’re here :)

We loved our heli tour above New York! It really is a experience you will never forget! The staff is very friendly and the pilot was very good, very good take-off and landing. We would definitely recommend booking with them, you won’t regret!
It was a once of a lifetime experience! Everybody should see New York from the air to get the best overview. It was fantastic!
It was an amazing experience.. NYC can be too close to your hands. I recommend to take the 30 min tour as 20 mins ca finish with a blink

Amazing tour to see New York highlights. Excellent service at arrival , everything well explained, very good captain explaining everything we were looking at, comfortable helicopter (not as much for me but I'm bigger than the average) but my wife had the chance to seat beside the captain, so she has an awesome experience there!!! Very good ans serious company with exceptional people working with.

Incredible experience!
The view is one in a life time. I recommend HeliNY for sure.
Crews are just great!

I think that when coming to New York you can't miss to make such an esperience!
The HeliNY crew Is very friendly and professional and Will make sure you nave a great Flight!

This was the highlight of our NY trip. To see this amazing city from above was an absolute pleasure with a team that was passionate and knowledgeable and with our best interests in mind. The views were superb and the commentary was informative. Highly recommended. A great way to finish our holiday.

I had read a lot of reviews of different companies before choosing this one, and I have to say I was not disappointed. The tour is very professionally organized, it was on time, the staff was very friendly and the instructions were very clear. Customer service representatives on the phone were excellent and very friendly. Due to the risk of rain I had called the day before and I was assured that if it would rain the next morning, I would be able to rebook to another day or be refunded, and I very much appreciated that. In the end we didn't have to change our slot. The ride was fantastic, even though it was a cloudy day, we had a very good view of the city and they main highlights, including Empire State Building, Chrysler Building, Freedom Tower, Times Square, Central Park, etc. The pilot pointed out all the sights to us so we didn't miss anything. The helicopter does not fly over Manhattan due to restrictions but around the island, but you still see everything and have a great view. The helicopter was comfortable and the flight was very smooth despite some wind. And no problem for pregnant women to fly. You will need to lock your bags in a locker but can bring cameras and phone. Every aspect of the tour was five stars, I can highly recommend it, definitely worth the money!

The helicopter trip was amazing. There were 6 family members and ALL had great seats. We had a personable pilot who pointed out countless interesting sites. Totally worth the money, and we would do it again!

Had a first time flier with us and two "seasoned" passengers. The flight itself was smooth and flew some beautiful scenery. The pilot and staff especially were so friendly and made the whole process go off with out a hitch! We will definitely recommend this company to our friends and family visiting. We suggest showing up early if you would enjoy hearing great stories from the staff.

This activity is absolutely worth every single penny! The views are amazing, the staff is very friendly and makes you feel at ease and 15 minutes is not too short! Would definitely recommend! Memories for life!

Your vacation will not be complete without a visit to HeliNY. Words cannot describe the experience of taking off in a helicopter and the views you will not see otherwise. Worth every penny you’ll Spend. Staff is friendly and welcoming as well.
People are very friendly and helpful. You have a beautiful view from helicpter. Everyone who visits New York should make this Tour. Tour that you will never forget.
Service is excellent from booking period up until the flight day. You have to see nyc the HELINY WAY!!
It was my birthday and I had a great time the staff was amazing with me and with all, great!!! Tour a must do if your in NYC!!
It was an amazing experience! The views were breath taking and staff were so helpful! Couldn’t stop smiling throughout the flight!! Lovely end to our honeymoon! Thank you so much to everyone!

Had an amazing experience with Helicopter Flight Services on the Manhattan Highlights Tour with my family - booked through adrenaline.com. All 7 of us (ages 6 to 78) got to fly in the same aircraft for a once in a lifetime experience. It was only 15mins but felt longer, and we got to see so many of the places we had visited on the ground in the previous few days - for that reason I recommend you explore Manhattan first and fly afterwards so you can see everything from a different perspective. Friendly staff, great pilot, smooth ride and overall the highlight of our US holiday. Great for young and old. If you hesitate based on cost - don't. You won't regretting spending the money!

This was a surprise gift from my husband and it did not disappoint! The views were spectacular and our pilot did a wonderful job. Jimmy made sure we saw it all and explained different points of interest. I felt safe the entire time, and the entire staff did a great job of explaining the procedures. Miguel was great to work with inside after the flight was over. Highly recommend this helicopter tour!

It was my first time flying in a helicopter and Jimmy did an amazing job as a pilot. Me and my wife had a wonderful time. Jimmy pointed out different points of interest and answered any questions I had. Definitely would recommend booking with them!

This experience is well worth the money, and it is expensive if you have a big family. It was very well run and professional, the only disappointment is that the pilot wasnt too keen on speaking about the city or landscape or buildings at all. It could be because he was busy concentrating on flying the helicopter so thats ok !

Of course, the price is quite high but you get what you paid for: a breath-taking view on the Hudson River and Manhattan during 15 min.
Nice pilot who gave the group some valuable explanations.

Worth to mention as well: due to erratic weather (cloudy or snow), we asked twice to reschedule our flight planning and they never made any difficulty to do so, client relationship was much appreciated!

At the end of the flight, you can buy a souvenir picture ($ 25 printed / $ 30 on an USB stick).
Dubious as ever due to some poor reviews we were amazed how good the whole trip was. Large luxury helicopter, fast and slick service. Great views and well looked after

We did this to celebrate our 10th wedding anniversary and am so glad we did. The staff were so friendly and helpful throughout, especially Jason. The flight itself took 15 minutes and just went past in the blink of an eye. Seeing the famous New York skyline from up high is something I will never forget.

Ground staff were friendly, explained everything. On time. The pilot pointed out the highlights. The overall experience was fantastic. If you want to take a helicopter ride, New York is the most amazing place to visit from the air. I would do it again and I would recommend it to anyone. Money well spent.
We were in NYC for our wedding and done this! What a fab experience and beautiful views of Manhattan and the islands a worthwhile way to see Manhattan definitely worth it!
Very well organized and very kind every single person in that building. Also I changed my date days before and there wasn't any problem, very quick and effective too.
Amazing!! Pilot was so friendly as well :) he explained everything very well. Got to see new york in a unique way
Do not miss it! Pricey, but memorable (less than 15 minutes). Felt very safe, the pilot narrated the sights throughout the flight.
The best thing we did in NYC, so worth the money. Great company, would definitely book with them again!
Well organised and felt very safe. What a fabulous way to see the City. My kids loved it. It was smooth as a butterfly taking off and landing and not noisy with the headphones provided.
nice flight, pleasent crew, comfortable helicopter, we had nice views of whole manhattan, safety is very high

This was our first time in a helicopter and what a place to do it. This company are friendly polite helpful and very safety conscious. We were looked after from start to finish, our pilot was really knowledgeable about what views we had. We bought I photo after (really recommended), unfortunately ours got stolen from our bag on the tube. We email the guys at Heli and they emailed us a copy. We were so happy, would highly recommend this company and we WILL use them in the future.
Thanks guys

Amazing from start to finish! Lovely helpful staff! The most beautiful views of the city with the pilot talking us through it all. 10/10 would highly recommend! The perfect way too see the city from a different prospective! Thank you.
The tour is amazing! Staff kinf and professional and even though I was a little bit scared at first there is no reason for that. The ride was safe and stable and the views breathtaking

The helicopter is spectacular. However, Tripadvisor made it bitter for me when I found out they charged me an extra $140 per person. The prices on HeliNY website is much cheaper so make sure to do your research properly.

I took the helicopter vine on 911 on my birthday I’ve always wanted to fly into the city my experience was amazing the staff was amazing very professional very nice the pilot that took us on the tour was amazing very funny I had a awesome time and I will definitely do it again!!!

The best tour of NYC we could have done! Unique, lovely staff with smiles and safety being the focus! We got amazing pictures and video. What we didn’t know at the beginning was that BOTH sides of the helicopter get to see the views! Don’t bother your neighbor by trying to take photos through them, you will get the same views on the way back! Thank you to the staff and pilot from our trip!
